| `cose-base.js` | [cose-base](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cose-base), iVis@Bilkent | MIT |
| `layout-base.js` | [layout-base](https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/layout-base), iVis@Bilkent | MIT |
